sanskrit: pṛthag rūpāṇi bahudhā paśūnām ekarūpo bhavati saṃ samṛddhyām | etāṃ tvacaṃ lohinīṃ tāṃ nudethāṃ grāvā śundhāti malaga iva vastrā ||
english: The many and various forms of cattle become one form in prosperity. Drive away this reddish skin; the pressing-stone purifies it as a washerman cleans garments.

sanskrit: janitrīva prati hṛṇyāsi sūnuṃ saṃ tvā dadhāmi pṛthivīṃ pṛthivyā | ukhāḥ kumbhīr vedyāṃ saṃcarantāṃ yajñāyudhair ājyenābhiṣiktāḥ ||
english: As a mother resents her son, you recoil; I unite you, O earth, with the earth. Let the cooking pots and jars move together upon the altar, consecrated with sacrificial implements and with ghee.

sanskrit: bhūmyāṃ tvā bhūmim adhi dhārayāmi tanūḥ samānī vikṛtā ta eṣā | yadyad yuktaṃ likhitam arpaṇaṃ ca tena mā susror api tad vapāmi ||
english: I place you, O earth, upon the earth; this body of yours is one, though transformed. Whatever is yoked, inscribed, and offered — with that I sow it, and may it not be heard by the two ears.

sanskrit: agniḥ pacan rakṣatu tvā purastād indro rakṣād dakṣiṇato mahitvā | somas tvā dṛṃhād dharuṇe pratīcyā uttarāt tvā varuṇaḥ saṃ dadātai ||
english: May Agni, the cook, protect you from the east; may Indra guard you from the south through his greatness; may Soma strengthen you from the west at the foundation; may Varuṇa unite you from the north.

sanskrit: ā yantu divaḥ pṛthivīṃ sacante bhūmyāḥ sacante urv antarikṣam | śuddhāḥ satīs tā u śundhanta eva tā naḥ svargam abhi lokaṃ nayantu ||
english: Let them come from heaven, accompanying the earth; they accompany the wide atmosphere from the earth. Being pure, may they themselves be purified; may they lead us to the heavenly world.

sanskrit: pūtāḥ pavitraiḥ pavante abhrād divaṃ ca yanti pṛthivīṃ ca lokān | tā jīvalā jīvadhanyāḥ pratiṣṭhāḥ pātra āsiktāḥ pary agnir endhām ||
english: Purified by purifiers, they flow pure; from the cloud they go to heaven and to the realms of the earth. Those life-giving ones, bearing the treasure of life, well-established, poured into the vessel — may Agni blaze around them.

sanskrit: uteva prabhvīr uta saṃmitāsa uta śukrāḥ śucayaś cāmṛtāsaḥ | tā odanaṃ dampatibhyāṃ pratiṣṭhā āpaḥ śikṣantīḥ pravatā sunāthāḥ ||
english: They are abundant, and also measured; they are bright, pure, and immortal. Those waters — a foundation for the rice-dish belonging to the couple — instructing, flowing downward, well-guided.

sanskrit: ud yodhayanty abhi valgantī taptāḥ phenam asyanti bahulaṃ ca bindum | yoṣeva dṛṣṭvā patim ṛtviyā yā- -etais taṇḍulair bhavatā sam āpaḥ ||
english: They foam up, leaping about when heated; they throw off abundant foam and drops. Like a young woman in season who, seeing her husband — with these grains of rice, O waters, be united.

sanskrit: saṃkhyātā stokāḥ pṛthivīṃ sacante prāṇāpānaiḥ saṃmitā oṣadhībhiḥ | asaṃkhyātā opyamānāḥ suvarṇāḥ sarvaṃ samāpaṃ śucayaḥ śucitvam ||
english: The counted drops accompany the earth; they are measured out with the vital breaths and with plants. The uncounted ones, being sown, shining like gold — all of them, the pure ones, completing everything, bring purity.

sanskrit: utthāpaya sīdato budhna enān adbhir ātmānam api saṃ sṛjantām | amāsi pātra udakaṃ yad etan mitās taṇḍulāḥ pradiśo yatīmāḥ ||
english: Raise up these that have settled at the bottom; may they unite themselves with the waters. The water that is in the vessel is unmixed — the measured rice-grains go forth in all directions.

sanskrit: pra yaccha parśuṃ tvarayā harantv ahiṃsanta oṣadhīr dāntu parvam | somo yāsāṃ pari rājyaṃ babhūva- -amanyutā vīrudho me bhavantu ||
english: Stretch forth the rib-bone; let them carry it swiftly. Without injuring, let them give the joint. May the plants over which Soma has sovereignty be without anger for me.

sanskrit: navaṃ barhir odanāya stṛṇīta priyaṃ hṛdaś cakṣuṣo valgv astu | tatra devāḥ saha devair viśantv imaṃ prāśnantu dakṣiṇato niṣadya ||
english: Spread fresh sacred grass for the rice-dish; let it be dear to the heart, pleasant to the eye. May the gods enter there together with the divine ones; seated to the south, may they partake of this.

sanskrit: vanaspate stīrṇam ā sīda barhir agniṣṭomaiḥ saṃmito devatābhiḥ | tvaṣṭeva rūpaṃ sukṛtaṃ svadhītyenā ehāḥ pari pātre dadṛśrām ||
english: O Lord of the Forest, sit down upon the spread sacred grass, measured out by the Agniṣṭoma sacrifices and the deities. Like Tvaṣṭṛ who has fashioned a beautiful form with his axe — may they be seen going around the vessel.

sanskrit: dhartā dhriyasva dharuṇe pṛthivyā acyutaṃ tvā devatāś cyāvayantu | taṃ dampatī jīvantau jīvaputrā udvāsayātaḥ pary agnidhānāt ||
english: O supporter, hold firm in the foundation of the earth; may the deities shake you, the unshakeable one. May that couple, alive, with living sons, move it away from around the fire-holder.

sanskrit: ṣaṣṭyai śaradbhyaḥ pari dadhma etaṃ svaḥ pakvenābhy aśnavātai | upainaṃ putrāḥ pitaraś ca sīdān imaṃ svargaṃ gamayāntam agne ||
english: For sixty autumns we wrap this around; with cooked food may the two enjoy heavenly bliss. May sons and fathers sit down near it; O Agni, lead this heavenly one onward.

sanskrit: sarvān samāgān abhijitya lokān yāvantaḥ kāmāḥ samapūpuras tān | vi gāhethām āyavanaṃ ca darvir ekasmin pātre adhyuddharainam ||
english: Having conquered all assembled worlds and as many desires as have been fulfilled — may the two of you plunge into it, O ladle, and into the place of resort; lift it up in the one vessel.

sanskrit: upa stṛṇīhi prathayā purastād ghṛtena pātram abhi ghārayedam | vāśrevosrā taruṇaṃ starasmim imaṃ devāso abhihiṃkarātha ||
english: Spread out below, extend in front; pour ghee upon this vessel. Like a lowing cow calling her calf to the litter — O gods, bellow toward this one.

sanskrit: upāstarīr akaro lokam etam uruḥ pṛthuś cāsamaḥ svargaḥ | tasmin suparṇo mahiṣaś śrayātai devā enaṃ devatābhyaḥ pra yacchān ||
english: You have spread out this world as a layer; this heaven is wide, broad, and incomparable. May the eagle and the great buffalo lean upon it; may the gods offer it to the divine beings.

sanskrit: yadyaj jāyā pacati tvat paraḥparaḥ patir vā jāya uta tvat tiraḥ | saṃ tat sṛjethāṃ saha vāṃ tad astu saṃ rādhayantau saha lokam etam ||
english: Whatever the wife cooks at a distance from you, or the husband from the wife, one beyond the other — may the two of you mingle that together; let it be in common for you both, prospering together, sharing this world.

sanskrit: yāvanto asyāḥ pṛthivīṃ sacante asmāt putrāḥ pari ye saṃbabhūvuḥ | sarvāṃs tān upa pātre hvayethāṃ nābhiṃ janānāḥ śiśavaḥ samāyan ||
english: As many sons as accompany this earth, who have been born from this one — call all of them to the vessel; the children, being born, shall come to the navel as their meeting-place.

sanskrit: vasor yā dhārā madhunā samaktā ghṛtena miśrā amṛtasya nābhayaḥ | sarvās tā ava rundhe svargaḥ ṣaṣṭyāṃ śaratsu nidhipā abhīcchāt ||
english: Those streams of wealth anointed with honey, mixed with ghee, the navels of immortality — heaven holds all of them back; the guardian of the treasury has come to claim it in sixty autumns.

sanskrit: nidhiṃ nidhipā abhy enam icchād anīśvarā abhitaḥ santv anye | asmābhir datto nihitaḥ svargas tribhiḥ kāṇḍais trīn svargān arukṣat ||
english: The guardian of the treasury seeks this treasury; let the others around be without mastery over it. This heaven, given and deposited by us, with its three kāṇḍas has ascended to the three heavens.

sanskrit: agnī rakṣas tapatu yad videvaṃ kravyāt piśāca iha mā pra pāsta | nudāma enam ava rudhmo asmad ādityā no aṅgirasaḥ sacantām ||
english: May Agni scorch the demon that is ungodly here; let not the flesh-eating piśāca spring forth here. We thrust it away, we ward it off from us; may the Ādityas and Aṅgirases accompany us.

sanskrit: ādityebhyo aṅgirobhyo madhv idaṃ ghṛtena miśraṃ prati vedayāmaḥ | śuddhahastau brāhmaṇasyānihatya- -enaṃ svargaṃ sukṛtāv apītam ||
english: To the Ādityas and Aṅgirases we make known this honey mixed with ghee. With pure hands, having not struck the brahmin's, both well-doers have drunk from this heaven.

sanskrit: idaṃ kāṇḍam uttamaṃ prāpam asya yasmāl lokāt parameṣṭhī samāpa | ā siñca sarpir ghṛtavat samaṅdhy eṣa bhāgo aṅgiraso no atra ||
english: This final kāṇḍa has reached the summit of it, from which world the highest one has attained completion. Pour the clarified butter along with the ghee, mixed well — this is our portion of the Aṅgirases here.

sanskrit: satyāya ca tapase devatābhyo nidhiṃ śevadhiṃ pari dadhma etam | mā no dyūte 'va gān mā samityāṃ mā smānyasmā ut sṛjatā purā mat ||
english: For truth, for austerity, and for the deities we wrap around this treasury, this blessed store. Let it not fail us in dice-play, nor in battle; do not release it to another before me.

sanskrit: na kilbiṣam atra nādhāro asti na yan mitraiḥ samamamāna eti | paktāraṃ pakvaḥ punar ā viśāsy anūnaṃ pātraṃ nihitaṃ no astu ||
english: There is no sin here, no deficiency; there is nothing that goes being measured equally among friends. The cooked food enters again into the cook; may the vessel placed before us be unfailing.

sanskrit: ahaṃ pacāmy aham id vadāmi mamed u karman karuṇe 'pi jāyāḥ | kaumāro loko ajaniṣṭa putro 'nv ārabhethāṃ vaya uttarāvat ||
english: I cook, and I alone speak; the deed is mine alone, even of the pitiable wife. A boyish world was born as a son; may the two of you take hold in succession; may our progeny be excelling.

sanskrit: priyaṃ priyāṇāṃ kṛṇavāma yātan tamas te hantu yatame dviṣanti | dhenur anaḍvān vayo yad anyat pauruṣeyam apa mṛtyuṃ nudantu ||
english: Let us make the beloved one dear among the beloved; darkness shall smite those who hate you. Let the milk-cow, the ox, the bird, and whatever else belongs to man drive away death.

sanskrit: sam agnayo vidur anyo anyaṃ ya oṣadhīḥ sacate yaś ca sindhūn | yāvanto devā divy ātapanti hiraṇyaṃ jyotir dadhato babhūva ||
english: The fires know one another — the one that accompanies the plants and the one that accompanies the rivers. As many gods as shine in heaven have come to hold the golden light.
